title: Some Couples Come With Private Captions
public_concept: A carousel of illustrated couple moments where the outside world sees one label, but love reads a kinder private caption.
human_truth: The right person does not describe you the way the room does. They caption you kindly.
emotional_obstacle: The format can become shallow label comedy unless every slide proves a real loving interpretation through visible behavior.
aachu_role: Aachu brings expressive behavior: drama, stress, excitement, dislikes, laughter, and tiny public performances.
zuv_role: Zuv actively interprets her kindly: he takes the drama seriously, listens before solving, enjoys her joy, joins her judgment, sees softness under toughness, and treasures her laugh.
emotional_arc: public hook -> paired private captions -> varied relationship receipts -> mutual kindness thesis
hard_boundaries: Do not copy Friends frames, actors, sets, labels, or sitcom blocking.
Do not reuse the rejected V2/V3 outputs as final visual references.
Do not make the labels mean or insulting.
Do not make Zuv a passive admirer in every slide.
Do not make this a generic quote-card deck.
